entries.title: Job 40:1
segments: Moreover Jehovah answered Job, and said,

entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: Shall he that cavilleth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.

entries.title: Job 40:3
segments: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments: Behold, I am of small account; What shall I answer thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:5
segments: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

entries.title: Job 40:6
segments: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

entries.title: Job 40:7
segments: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

entries.title: Job 40:8
segments: Wilt thou even annul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be justified?

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

entries.title: Job 40:10
segments: Deck thyself now with excellency and dignity; And array thyself with honor and majesty.

entries.title: Job 40:11
segments: Pour forth the overflowings of thine anger; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

entries.title: Job 40:12
segments: Look on every one that is proud, [and] bring him low; And tread down the wicked where they stand.

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden [place].

entries.title: Job 40:14
segments: Then will I also confess of thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments: Behold now, behemoth, which I made as well as thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

entries.title: Job 40:16
segments: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the muscles of his belly.

entries.title: Job 40:17
segments: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

entries.title: Job 40:18
segments: His bones are [as] tubes of brass; His limbs are like bars of iron.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: He is the chief of the ways of God: He [only] that made him giveth him his sword.

entries.title: Job 40:20
segments: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field do play.

entries.title: Job 40:21
segments: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and the fen.

entries.title: Job 40:22
segments: The lotus-trees cover him with their shade; The willows of the brook compass him about.

entries.title: Job 40:23
segments: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though a Jordan swell even to his mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?
